title: Translation interpolation identifies derivative, Hankel and logarithmic branch dimensions

statement.quantifiers: Every nonzero characteristic-zero polynomial P in n variables, with logarithms at distinct poles ell_i=log(1+z/i).
statement.assertion: The total derivative span dimension equals shuffle-lift Hankel rank, branch-span dimension and minimum rational homogeneous linear ODE or linear-readout system dimension. A size2n−1 squarefree product has dimension2^n but vanishing order n.
assumptions: Characteristic zero; polynomial coefficients with finitely generated field embedding or complex proof.
Independent logarithmic poles, single-valued rational coefficient readouts.
Finite faithful linear representations; arbitrary nonlinear circuit readout excluded from the lower bound.

inputs: Polynomial P and derivative-space promise if an efficient algorithm is requested.
outputs: Exact invariant and matching differentiation realization; representation-specific exponential examples.
interface.precision: Exact analytic/algebraic statement; no numerical logarithm transcendence assumption.
costs: Computing or materializing the entire derivative closure can cost exponentially many states.
The small derivative promise is not acquired from a general small circuit.
Black-box evaluation costs and arithmetic constant bits remain separate.

proof_mechanism: Loops translate one log by2pi i while leaving others fixed.
Integer-lattice interpolation spans every derivative and proves log algebraic independence even over C(z).
Rescale Hankel columns by gamma-factorial to obtain derivative coefficient rows.
Branch span bounds all homogeneous rational linear solution/readout spaces.
The derivative basis supplies commuting nilpotent residues sum C_i/(z+i); eliminate rows for the matching scalar ODE.
obstructions: Large linear ODE order does not imply large logarithmic contact: squarefree product counterexample.
Independent iterated integrals are not a homomorphism for commutative multiplication.
Prior small-derivative hitting sets must remain attributed, not a new general PIT result.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove a bound for nonlinear readouts without exponential derivative expansion, or exhibit a small uniform counterfamily; preserve the field, degree and bit-cost contract.

review.source_reported: Source written derivation and finite checks reported, precise original scopes retained; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
